title: Kyckr MCP Values
description: Values for the Kyckr MCP Helm chart. NestJS MCP server for the Kyckr company-registry API. Exposure uses base chart Gateway API routes (no custom Ingress).

mcpConfig.description: Configuration for the Kyckr MCP Server, mapped to environment variables (MCP_API_KEY, KYCKR_API_BASE_URL, KYCKR_API_KEY, KYCKR_DEFAULT_CUSTOMER_REFERENCE, KYCKR_DEFAULT_CONTACT_EMAIL).

apiKey.description: Shared secret protecting the MCP endpoint. The server mounts itself at /<MCP_API_KEY>/mcp and 404s every other path, so this value is the credential and the URL prefix at once: it is required, and there is no unauthenticated surface to fall back on. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Rotating it moves the endpoint, so every configured client has to be updated in the same window. fromSecretProvider is auto-collected into the chart's SecretProviderClass — no separate secretProvider.vaults entry needed.

apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the Kyckr REST API. The default is Kyckr's test environment, matching the application's own default; point it at https://api.kyckr.com/v2 for real registry data. Must be https — the API key travels as a Bearer token on every request, which templates/_helpers.tpl enforces.

apiKey.description: Kyckr API key, sent as a Bearer token on every Kyckr call. Production keys draw on a paid credit balance, so a key belonging to the other environment than apiBaseUrl is a billing incident rather than a 401. fromSecretProvider is auto-collected into the chart's SecretProviderClass — no separate secretProvider.vaults entry needed.

defaultCustomerReference.description: Customer reference forwarded to Kyckr on paid calls so the credit spend can be reconciled per deployment. Omit to send none.

defaultContactEmail.description: Contact email forwarded to Kyckr on document orders that need manual follow-up. Omit to send none, which leaves those orders without a reachable owner.
